CHAPTER 14 · ITEM 07 / 12

Production and cost curves

Average and marginal formulas平均與邊際公式

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate AFC = FC/Q, AVC = VC/Q, ATC = TC/Q = AFC + AVC, and MC = ΔTC/ΔQ = ΔVC/ΔQ when fixed cost does not change. Average costs require Q > 0.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

平均成本以各項總成本除產量，ATC=AFC+AVC。FC 不變時，MC 也可由 VC 的變化計算。Q=0 時不能計平均成本。

AFC=FC/Q, AVC=VC/Q, ATC=TC/Q=AFC+AVC. MC=ΔTC/ΔQ=ΔVC/ΔQ when FC stays fixed. Average costs are undefined at zero quantity.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：At Q=4,FC=20,VC=28: AFC=5,AVC=7,ATC=12. If Q=5 has TC=60, MC=(60−48)/1=12.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

FC=12,VC=18,Q=3. ATC? 平均總成本？
